el.¿Qué es el Posgrado en Yoga Esencial?: What is the Postgraduate in Essential Yoga?
el.Son tres meses de formación avanzada, on: Three months of advanced training, online and live, devoted to three tools for teaching: Chair Yoga, Yoga Nidra and creative visualizations.
el.¿Puedo hacer el Posgrado sin haber hecho: Can I take the Postgraduate Program without having done the Teacher Training?
el.Sí, si ya tenés práctica, una formación: Yes, if you already have a practice, previous Yoga training, or are already teaching. If you're coming from the Teacher Training, it's the natural next step: same day, same time and same group.
el.De septiembre a noviembre de 2027, los m: From September to November 2027, on Tuesdays from 19 to 21 hs, Argentina time. One topic per month.
el.¿Cuánto sale el Posgrado?: How much does the Postgraduate Program cost?
el.Un pago de $420.000 o tres cuotas de $17: One payment of $420.000 or three installments of $175.000.
el.¿Puedo cursar un solo módulo?: Can I take just one module?
